title: Reliability-first student persona
content:
Persona: Meera, 20, third-year student with back-to-back labs and a hard 30-minute break. She will pay a little more to be sure food arrives on time and is safe.
Needs: fast delivery, live tracking, verified vendors, hygiene confidence.
Pains: late orders, cold food, unknown kitchens, no way to see where the order is.
Messaging:
- Headline: Hot food at your hostel in 15 minutes.
- Proof: ratings, verified-vendor badges, on-time guarantee.
- Offer: live tracking on every order.
- Tone: calm, confident, reassuring.
rationale: Positioning 'Fast and trusted' for college students means speed and proof must lead, so the persona stresses reliability, tracking and vendor verification.
